name: Arale
source:
"I'm scared, Teko. Scared that you might do something cruel."

A partner robot created by Teko. Though timid, he's quick to make bluffs. His emotions are always fluctuating. Will do anything to protect Teko, but also scolds Teko if he does something wrong.

[From [url=https://x.com/SpikeChunsoft_e/status/1932875480853553181]official Twitter[/url]]
